title: Microsoft Teams: Room health signals and notifications in Teams Rooms on Windows
description: When critical issues impact room functionality, users see a banner notification on both the front-of-room display and console in Teams Rooms on Windows.  Room health signals help get issues resolved quickly and ensure productive meetings. Available with Teams Rooms Pro.
